description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC Controller class 'OptionsValueController' responsible for managing CRUD operations and web interactions related to product option values in an administrative web interface. It includes methods for displaying, editing, creating, saving, paginating, and deleting product option values, as well as handling image uploads and removals.

classes.name: OptionsValueController
classes.description: A Spring MVC Controller class for managing product option values, including CRUD operations, image handling, and web interface interactions in the admin panel.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the list of product option values; sets the menu and returns the view for listing options.

methods.name: displayOptionEdit
methods.description: Handles GET requests to edit an existing product option value identified by 'id'; delegates to 'displayOption'.

methods.name: displayOption
methods.description: Prepares and displays the form for creating or editing a product option value, including loading existing data if 'optionId' is provided.

methods.name: saveOption
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save a new or existing ProductOptionValue, including validation, image upload, and persistence.

methods.name: pageOptions
methods.description: Handles POST requests for paginating and returning product option values in JSON format for AJAX frontend calls.

methods.name: deleteOptionValue
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a product option value by its ID, returning success or failure status.

methods.name: removeImage
methods.description: Handles POST requests to remove an image associated with a product option value.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set active menu items in the model for UI navigation.
